critique: The note proves the advertised matched pointwise mean-absolute-risk rate on the exact known-uniform, bounded-overlap Bernoulli class, including a fixed-n same-class converse and a total estimator; no conjecture or one-sided surrogate remains in the headline theorem. Its contribution is nevertheless confined to resolving the converse on a strict, highly structured subclass for which the corresponding upper-rate phenomenon was already published, so it does not establish a new general CATE frontier. The practical interpretation is only a precision benchmark: the paper supplies neither adaptation nor inference nor evidence that the cited forest and R-learner workflows attain the rate. These scope and significance constraints keep the projected leading-econometrics-journal score below the stronger broad minimax papers in the calibration set.
